proposed_capability: Multi-hour, resumable local-agent hidden Build/Buy object scouting goal using read-only deterministic rotations, bounded checkpoint ledger, per-batch evidence receipts and hard stop gates; reuses current P04 setup and scene/lease safeguards instead of repeatedly typing cheats.
player_save_control_impact: NONE. The scout only emits suggestions and writes bounded ignored dist checkpoint records. It cannot launch game, type, click, change funds/speed/saves, start local tasks, auto-run or override operator. Per-batch local agent consent and scene gates remain independent.
expected_outcome: A 4-hour-default opt-in reusable goal with safe start/next/record/status/pause/resume/stop CLI; a deterministic rotating list of searches, checkpoint and deduplication by observed item labels and packs; success/coverage metrics and no-result/expiry limits; exact P04 guide and live receipt revalidation every search; P04 handoff and dispatch integrative visibility.
negative_tests: start rejects invalid duration or session ID
next with no player consent/lease/game build or P04 setup abstains
record duplicate batch receipt cannot double count
duplicate item across batches counts once
unknown and nonzero price never treated as free
no-match increments counts without inventing objects
no threshold goal misreported as actual game completion
P04 guide and BI-002 remain unchanged
rollback_path: Revert feature PR; any local checkpoint stays under ignored dist and does not touch personal saves or existing gameplay packages. Existing hidden-object discovery remains available.
unresolved_unknowns: Windows Sims process and actual patch/pack state are inaccessible to this chat runtime
No local autonomous game-host adapter attached to provider; real 4-hour live run cannot be certified by CI
Target counts are aspirational, and some debug items may have nonzero or unknown cost
External agent runner owns looping between CLI calls; no system scheduler is requested
